author: GameTrailers
description:
'Curators, compose yourselves, it’s time for clay-os…' Watch the Two Point Museum: Arty-Facts launch trailer as the DLC arrives on Nintendo Switch 2. In Two Point Museum: Arty Facts, this new gallery-stroke-museum is seeking creative curators to revitalize an old industrial port by collecting and commissioning works of Art. 

The Arty-Facts DLC features a new museum location called Undee Docks, new Art Experts, an unexplored expedition map through Zara’s Sketchbook, 27+ art exhibits including Famous Works, new gift shop items, new themed cafe items, five new interactive displays, new themed items and decorations, and a new Art Studio room to create original art pieces. 

The Two Point Museum: Arty-Facts DLC is available now on Nintendo Switch 2. It is also available on PC, Xbox X|S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Two Point Museum: Arty-Facts - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

You can now engage in multi-threaded conversations with Fallen Preyers, making pivotal choices that impact both gameplay and story. Witchfire is out now in Early Access on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). The Revelations update for Witchfire is out today, June 18, 2026.

description:

In Junkster, play as thrifty little construction robot named UM-13 (UM if you’re feeling resourceful) whose cargo ship crash-lands on the trashed lands of a danger-filled junkyard planet, and your job is to unleash the power of scrap by finding usable materials amongst the tat to salvage your broken-down vehicle and find your lost cargo of human artifacts, starting off armed with nothing but your trusty robo-wrench.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Bandai Card Games reveal their new project, The NARUTO CARD GAME! Check out the latest teaser trailer! The NARUTO CARD GAME is confirmed for a 2027 global release.

The official Naruto Card Game is officially in development. Bandai has confirmed a release window for this new TCG project.

Bandai recently shared a teaser for their upcoming Naruto Card Game, confirming that the title is currently in production. This announcement provides a clear look at what fans can expect from the next major entry in the Bandai TCG lineup. If you are a fan of collectible card games or the Naruto franchise, this update outlines the official timeline established by the publisher.

The project is currently slated for a 2027 launch. While specific gameplay mechanics remain under wraps, the teaser video established a clear roadmap for future updates. Fans can mark their calendars for July 29, 2026, which is the date for the next major news drop regarding this new card game. 

#NarutoCardGame #Gaming #IGN
title: NARUTO CARD GAME - Official Teaser Trailer
